_doc: Apify retest (preliminary), Oct 26, 2026. Counts recomputed from the raw run logs at hazeydata/agentwebindex 286991a4 (PR #31). One run per setup, n=21 (short week, below the usual minimum of 25). Search rows re-graded with the repo's tables.regrade (grader canon-2026-10-20); the web-fetch log is a browser set and is scored straight from the log, so raw and regraded counts are the same by construction.
chart_350_note: 350px variant for screens under 960px: the same words and numbers as the main chart, re-wrapped on a 252-unit viewBox with 12-unit minimum text so it renders at 13px or more from 320px to 959px.
chart_source: 2026-10-26 Apify retest package chart.svg (Her? and Tobias)
alt: Bar chart, preliminary: on 21 AgentWebIndex news items, apify/web-fetch passed 19 and apify/rag-web-browser, with a 240-second timeout, passed 16, with 0 timeouts. One run per setup on a short set.
